videos.name: Three Storages
videos.overview: The crew's initial findings are at odds with their knowledge of the research station. Split into threes, the members set out to look for the sample.

videos.name: Cause of Death
videos.overview: Jian's body cam captures a startling moment of life and death. Submerged in sweat, Gong Soochan shows worrisome signs of an unusual infection.

videos.name: The Truth Comes Out
videos.overview: Han Yunjae updates the director and gets access to a restricted area. The crew learns of the sample's powers and the true motive behind their mission.

videos.name: Secret Storage
videos.overview: Recalling her sister's encrypted message, Jian searches the database for Luna. A young intruder and a double-crosser emerge from the shadows.

videos.name: Key to Salvation
videos.overview: E2, Ryu Taesuk and the samples go missing. Seeing a familiar name on the intruder, Jian follows her down the vents for answers.

videos.name: Luna
videos.overview: Jian opens a hard drive that chronicles Song Wonkyung's life and work on the station. Meanwhile, others uncover the remains of the experiment.

videos.name: The Silent Sea
videos.overview: Racing against time as the research station falls under destruction, the surviving crew members decide on the fate of the mission — and their own.
